design: Short wiry herald with a pointed forehead crest, long slim mandibles and a compact upright fan of short dreadlocks. Overlapping ivory ceremonial tunic strips edged red, slim shoulder cape, strong cloth calf wraps and a narrow belt. Left hand carries a small bronze hand chime by its ring; right holds a short announcement scroll tube. Light tan speckled hide, one foot subtly forward.
